# Vendored Script Module

`mcp-bridge.pts` is copied from:

- Project: `Jcorderop02/packet-tracer-mcp`
- Source: `extension/dist/mcp-bridge.pts`
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE` in this directory

The file is used only to validate the Script Engine transport for the first
end-to-end experiment. The project should replace it with its own minimal,
token-authenticated Script Module before the final delivery.
